title: Feedback ring persistence validation
command: cargo test -p feedback-api -p spec-api -p session-api -p rule-api && cargo test -p ticket-api missing_rule
detail: Validates distributed ring handlers persist feedback records in their owning domains (frontend ingestion in feedback-api, execution recompute in spec-api, transcript mining in session-api, no-match signaling seam in rule-api, and missing-rule follow-up in ticket-api).
